Ilmater

The Crying God
The One Who Endures
The Broken God

Stats

Race

Deity
Ilmater is the god of endurance and suffering. He is associated with the domains Life and Twilight.
“
Above all else - the weary soul knows itself better than you can. Do not condescend, do not assume, do not impose. Simply avail yourself as a tool to the weary - let them know you can be used however they might need.
„
— On the Weary, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan

Overview

The Crying God[1] protects the oppressed and persecuted. His clergy the Church of Ilmater is sworn to alleviate suffering, even if that means taking on that pain personally.

This deity can be selected by player character Clerics.

In Act Three, the party can visit a temple of Ilmater in Rivington. The Open Hand Temple has recently lost its first cleric  Father Lorgan. He was murdered by a cruel killer who escaped undetected. The party can solve this murder case during ⁠Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders.
